fixes: First-time setup installs checksum-pinned AbletonOSC and BeatMind extensions from the signed bundle without a separate runtime download.
Setup runs in the background with visible progress, completion and error messages; cloud reconnect does not block local setup.
Custom User Library selection is persisted; incomplete or unrecognized existing integrations are not overwritten.
A connected Bridge that cannot inspect Live returns actionable setup and Control Surface instructions before any production action.

tests.real_setup_button: Source GUI button invoked with the actual pinned AbletonOSC archive and an empty temporary User Library. Setup completed during simulated cloud reconnect; completion instructions were visible in the screenshot.
tests.packaged_integration: Signed binary passed fresh-install and repeated-install checks in a temporary library.
tests.packaged_audio: Actual four-stem separation passed using a generated tone; HTTPS and WebSocket TLS checks passed.
tests.updater: Actual updater using local DMG transport rejected a bad checksum without replacing the previous app, installed the signed replacement, and retained the previous app. Fresh-copy signature and Gatekeeper checks passed.
tests.production_browser: 1440px and 390px: login, signup, forgot-password, guide and changelog returned 200 without page errors, broken assets or horizontal overflow. Invalid sign-in produced readable validation; logged-out dashboard redirected to login.
tests.production_api: ECS stable; health ok; Bedrock configured; unauthenticated chats and Bridge status returned 401.

installer.notarization: Accepted; ticket stapled; disk image verified
installer.scope: Apple Silicon; local testing on macOS 15.7.7. Sylvia's independent Mac remains unverified.

preservation.music_and_integration: No Ableton music commands, original project edits or changes to the user's existing AbletonOSC integration were made during these release checks.
preservation.production_configuration: Only BEATMIND_RELEASE_SHA changed. Payment settings, secret references, provider configuration, ECS roles and storage were preserved.
preservation.rollback: Frontend snapshot releases/before-20261002-29525673/; prior ECS task beatmind-api:82; immutable Bridge 1.3.9 retained.
preservation.excluded: No credentials, marketing media, music projects or temporary QA scripts included in release commits.

remaining_confirmation: On Sylvia's Mac: install Bridge 1.3.10, choose the correct User Library if customized, run setup, save and restart Live, select AbletonOSC in an empty Control Surface slot, then perform read-only Live Set inspection.
Fresh macOS privacy-permission prompts and independent first-time audio capture remain unverified.
Live payments remain deferred by the user. This release does not certify every third-party plugin or subjective music quality.
